Name: Farm Cave Mine Warp
Author: ejc5million
Description:
Adds a minecart in the farm cave that warps you to level 1 of the mines and in there is another minecart to take you back.

[size=4][b]Things to note[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]It wont let you access the mines from the cave until spring y1 day 5 because that is the day you can normally start accessing the mines in the vanilla game, if you try it will result in the pop up saying "Minecart track to the mines is still being built, come back later"
[*]The first time you go to the mines if you go through this warp you will need to go up the ladder and exit the mines to trigger the cutscene with Marlon who will give you the rusty sword
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[/list] 2. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
﻿3. Run the game using SMAPI.
